texts:
Put your phone in the cradle, open Drive, and your agent rides along.

The page starts in Driving: a face, a voice, four controls, and no keyboard. Hold Talk and speak. The reply comes back in one or two short sentences, spoken in full and clamped to two lines on screen. Park, and Type unlocks. Night is the default, because a bright panel at speed is glare.
It is the same talk loop the site already runs (mic, transcript, reply, voice, lip sync on a rigged avatar), sized for a car panel. Runs on a head unit browser or a phone in a cradle: three.ws/drive
"Repeat that", "stop talking", "louder" and "night mode" are answered by the page itself, with no round trip to a server.
